name: Kamiamakusa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kamiamakusa city emblem in green, light blue and orange: a green oval within light blue and orange curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Kamiamakusa, a city in Kumamoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 31 March 2004.
